interfaces.identity: Stable epoch/occurrence/support IDs; duplicate stage/read adds nothing; altered original support/descriptor or another occurrence claiming that support is rejected. Reinterpretation names the original occurrence. An unheard zero-assignment span creates no record.
interfaces.conditional_support: Input is one already constructed path-local activity payload and joint conditional episode/context path rows. available_support=assignment_seconds/(original_end-original_start). Multiply conditional path membership once to obtain r_eoc. Exact path aliases deduplicate; conflicting aliases or total path mass>1 fail. Unknown episode/context and unretained mass stay unresolved.
interfaces.projection: Each chosen sealed path supplies membership alone to SectionHistory.commit, with original assignment seconds and its cached correspondence. No second acoustic-support factor, extra matching invocation or invented product of independent episode/context marginals.
interfaces.deadline: original_end+lag; accept provisional support and owned accent evidence through that deadline. advance may process later but freezes the deadline and original occurrence time separately from delivery time. Post-deadline evidence cannot be installed as provisional support.
interfaces.revision: Metadata-only after sealing. Distance=max absolute difference of any joint episode/context support cell or unassigned available support against the original sealed write. Strict>threshold flags that original occurrence once; flag is sticky and rate=flagged_original_occurrences/all_supported_sealed_occurrences.
interfaces.accent_ownership: Frozen nonnegative shares per canonical admitted accent sum<=1. Keep the original event/evidence and receipt time. Credit staged or later-staged owners through their deadline; preserve original ending descriptors. Repeated receipt adds nothing, changed owners fail, post-seal receipts are explicit support loss.
interfaces.lag_and_adjacency: Physical union of complete original known audio/association hops on the supplied stable lineage. Never borrow a partial future raw hop, use assignment magnitude as physical coverage, or replace original endpoints with commitment time.
interfaces.coarse_snapshot: Completed nonsuperseded exact occurrence/support query on the declared generation lineage. Both whole query end and maximum full supporting-audio endpoint must be<=original span end and within0.1s. Actual cache receipt<=original commitment deadline; late worker delivery never backdates availability. Missing qualification/entry remains unknown.
interfaces.interference: Only target episodes with first original occurrence end strictly earlier than this span end are eligible. Known competing assigned support times exp(-coarse_cost) contributes the lower bound. Unknown-episode/unassigned available support expands the upper bound; unavailable similarity gives[0,potentially competing support]. Recurrence support is returned separately; acoustic gap uncertainty is not added once per overlapping occurrence.
interfaces.context: A_e accumulates all committed r_eo including unknown context; U_ec accumulates resolved retained contexts. Edge=U/A, no renormalization of unknown or evicted contexts. These are uncapped membership totals, not capped episode strength. Later metadata cannot rewrite them; retired stable context handles remain unresolved.
interfaces.storage: Exhaustive sealed/receipt/revision audit retention for finite input. Pending count defaults65536, with explicit overflow/late-ending loss; count guard alone does not implement128-byte endpoints or bound all live memory.
